headline: OPay COO Says Nigerian Firms Must Build for the Worst Days
summary: OPay Chief Operating Officer Dotun Daniel Adekunle stated that Nigeria's most durable companies are built to survive its worst days, describing stubbornness as a business model in Africa.
why: OPay is a prominent financial technology company operating in Africa's largest economy, providing insights into operational resilience amidst infrastructure and currency challenges.

impacts.why: Executive commentary on navigating the local macroeconomic environment.
